name: an-in-place-sed-of-a-locked-path-is-still-refused
description: The wall beside fixture 114's door, asserted end to end because a narrowing of a gate is only defensible with its limit shipped next to it: the same sed, the same locked path, one flag different, and the lock refuses with the override named. If T513 had withdrawn the refusal from sed as a WORD rather than from the one shape proven to print, this fixture would go green in the wrong direction
